real_errors.title: First-article U3.3-to-R127.1 check 'must read open' fails an intact board in one polarity
real_errors.evidence: Board: QSPI_IO2 = {U1.1, U3.3}; PYRO1_GATE_N = {U1.3, R126.1, R127.1}; R127 1k to GND, R126 220R + R128 10k to GND: R127.1 to GND 1k || 10.22k = 910.9 Ohm. With the meter's positive lead on R127.1 the VSS-side input clamps of U1.1 (PE2, FT_h, DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 p64; Table 120 note 4 negative injection) and U3.3 conduct: diode drop + 0.91 kOhm, a finite ohms reading and about 1.0-1.5 V on diode test, never 'open'. Reversed: open or a slowly rising reading (3V3 capacitance). A bridge reads near 0 Ohm both ways. The source (round23_safety_severity_check.md:212-213) required 'no beep and > 100 Ohm'. Sweep of the other meter / continuity / resistance checks in ORDERING 8.3 (harness pin identity 605, J121.2 < 0.1 V 659, igniter resistance 661 (parallel board path >= about 11 kOhm + diode, negligible against 1-2 Ohm and a positive pass band), NRST ratio 666, R166 and harness resistance 669-670, J410.3 etc. voltages 649), M3_R10 and the binding note: no other check has an ignored parallel path or polarity that changes its verdict.
all_places: tools/test_r10_check.py:407 (asserts the phrase; update with the text)
real_errors.concrete_fix: Replace 'it must read open' with: 'in resistance mode, both polarities: an intact board reads above 0.9 kOhm both ways (red lead on R127.1: a diode drop plus about 0.91 kOhm through the U1 / U3 input clamps; reversed: open or slowly rising); a continuity beep or under 100 Ohm in either polarity is a bridge: reject'. Regenerate the binding note; update the test string. Text / check only.
